label_source.name: ESA WorldCover
label_source.role: Reference land-cover map used as training and evaluation labels. It is a model product with its own error, not ground truth.

notes: This is a research-only sweep. The production defaults are not modified by this experiment.
limitations: Reported change is change in a reflectance-derived vegetation index. It does not establish land-cover conversion and no causal process is attributed to it.
Only pixels valid in both periods contribute, so the analysed area differs between region pairs.
